audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 row reads 'Skill' in both layers; the packet chart and the mirror audit both give that row to Ryze.
audit.why: packet.levelChart index 4 = Ryze; mirrorFindings: 'Row 4 flipped to Ryze in both layers, rating raised to match'. whys[4] already says Ryze spikes at 6.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] both to Ryze, rating to 3/10 so the two directions agree.

audit.why: Spikes are correctly placed: you own 1-5 while Ryze is mana-bound, he spikes at 6 with Realm Warp, then Tear/Archangel's. Added the 180s rank-1 Realm Warp cooldown so the level-6 spike is actionable.
audit.corrected: Realm Warp named at 180s in the level-6 spike text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Rune Prison (W) only ROOTS a target that already has Spell Flux (E) on it. Without flux it is a slow. Every line said 'bait the root' as if it rooted unconditionally.
audit.why: Riot text, W: 'traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' W cd 11/10.5/10/9.5/9, range 615; E cd 3.5/3.25/3/2.75/2.5, range 615.
audit.corrected: Sidestep Spell Flux and Rune Prison is only a slow — that is the whole lane, and it is now written into the cooldowns block, the Do's, the level-6 phase, the report and the spikes.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Rune Prison only roots if Spell Flux is on you first — dodge the E and the root is just a slow, then Cyclone him.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison: 11s at rank 1, 615 range — it only roots through Spell Flux, otherwise it is a slow. - Spell Flux: 3.5s, so the flux comes first. - Realm Warp: 180s at rank 1 — a rotation tool, not a duel tool.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It roots only through Spell Flux — dodge his E and the cage is a slow you walk out of.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — E-Q shred, W out, R knockup.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux (E) — sidestep the orb and it is a 615-range slow. Then E-Q shred, W out, R.

edits.before: Ryze spikes with Realm Warp (R) utility and enough mana to spam Overload (Q) and Rune Prison (W) root; his root plus flux combo can now punish a sloppy dive. Bait the W root before you commit.
edits.after: Ryze spikes with Realm Warp (R) at 180s and enough mana to chain Spell Flux (E) into Rune Prison (W); the root only lands through flux, so sidestep the orb and the cage is only a slow.

edits.before: You stay ahead through levels 4-5 while your all-in still beats his mana pool. At 6 Ryze flips it: Realm Warp utility and spammable Overload plus Rune Prison root let him punish dives, so bait the W before committing.
edits.after: You stay ahead through levels 4-5 while your all-in still beats his mana pool. At 6 Ryze flips it: Realm Warp utility and spammable Overload plus Rune Prison root let him punish dives, so sidestep Spell Flux — the cage then only slows.

edits.before: Root you with Rune Prison and burst with Overload
edits.after: Land Spell Flux first so Rune Prison roots you

notes: Overload (Q) is on a 5s cooldown but is RESET by his other basic abilities, so it is not a punish window and I did not write one. Realm Warp is a teleport portal for allies, not an escape — the inherited text never claimed otherwise, so it was left alone. No spell-shield/QSS/tenacity claims made (needsResearch empty = unknown).
